references.retrieval: Direct publisher HTML; abstract, methods and limitations reviewed. No individual observations imported.
references.cohort: 512 male NCAA Division I athletes, ages 18–23, one university; 2628 offseason testing observations over 15 years; 11 positional groups.
references.methods: Bench/squat one-repetition maximum or estimate from 2–5 reps; flight-time vertical jump; standing broad jump; touchpad-start electronic 40-yard timing; barefoot mass recorded to one pound.
references.finding: Group improvements diminished over successive collegiate years.
limitations: One collegiate programme, not an NFL population or national demographic sample.
Changing training and early NFL entry may affect later-year summaries.
No regional composition, external girths or joint body-shape/capacity coefficients adopted.
Test methods require reconciliation before combining with Combine or other observations.

references.retrieval: Direct publisher abstract, not full methods or individual observations.
references.cohort: Nine NCAA Division I FCS linebackers measured at three seasonal timepoints.
references.methods: DXA composition, vertical jumps and loaded squat jumps.
references.finding: No statistically significant seasonal composition or power differences reported.
limitations: Small position-specific sample; null significance does not establish individual equivalence.
No NFL annual trajectory or anatomy-to-performance equation adopted.

implementationInferences: Persist physical observations and method metadata separately from evaluation ratings and natural appearance.
Use measured dimensions as constraints; jointly fit estimated build and capacities only from compatible data, preserving residual variation.
Dated weight/composition events update compatible regional bulk through the stable skeleton. Capacity-only events alter behavior without rerolling anatomy.
Retain individual training histories and plateaus; validate any proposed professional development rates independently.
acceptanceStatus: Three physical-transition fixtures added to plan; execution remains pending.
